in_marathi.name: Kashinath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Kashi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kashinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kashi refers to the ancient city of Varanasi, the spiritual capital of India. Lord Shiva is the deity of this place. The name Kashinath thus means 'God of Kashi' or 'Lord of Varanasi'.

in_bengali.name: Kashinath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Kashi
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kashinath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kashi refers to the ancient city of Varanasi, the spiritual capital of India. Lord Shiva is the deity of this place. The name Kashinath thus means 'God of Kashi' or 'Lord of Varanasi'.
